checks.criterion: Retain the unchanged official English SRD 5.2.1 PDF with successful bounded acquisition, SHA256, size, publisher/title/version/language/acquisition provenance, actual page count and verified legal/section page locators.
checks.procedure: Verify retained official source bytes, bounded acquisition provenance, SHA/size/title/version/language/page count; independently render legal/contents pages and verify each section locator.

checks.criterion: Preserve source attribution and license evidence limited to the acquired SRD contents; explicitly record unacquired PHB/DMG/Monster Manual source revisions and unresolved rights/catalog gates, without claiming full 2024 coverage or a reviewed production RightsGrant.
checks.procedure: Compare license/attribution evidence to official publisher and PDF; inspect manifest for explicit missing core-book revision/errata/catalog/rights and no production grant/full coverage claims.

checks.criterion: Provide a bounded read-only development verifier for the pinned source manifest and bytes, with observed success and safe failure for corrupted bytes, malformed metadata, mixed source edition and missing required full-book sources; no game runtime schema or catalog implementation.
checks.procedure: Execute pinned verifier on actual source and independent malformed/corrupt/mixed-edition/missing-book fixtures; distinguish partial manifest validity from required full-source admission.

checks.criterion: Retain exact committed source/evidence identities, commands and results, relevant PDF visual inspection, known gaps and scoped devlog; edits remain confined to the independent source-pin area.
checks.procedure: Confirm exact clean commit and allowed changed paths; retain independent commands, source/artifact identities and PDF visual observations; append scoped devlog with honest gaps.
